outputContract.scope: Language context only (zero authority over country, currency, payment, or permissions)

productionModeFirewall.rule: PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT => resolverMode IMMUTABLY FORCED TO PRODUCTION

signals: NODE_ENV === 'production' (unless running in explicit Preview or Test)

untrustedInputsBlocked: Guest cookie 'rentipid_pref' payload injection (constant-time verification rejects forbidden keys)
Unsigned cookie 'rentipid_locale' (contains only locale tag string)
Client state / browser localStorage (client components pass string initialLocale only)

apiGatewayDefense.guestPreferencesApi: PROHIBITED_GUEST_UPDATE_KEYS rejects resolverMode, localeMode, qaMode with HTTP 400
apiGatewayDefense.accountPreferencesApi: PROHIBITED_UPDATE_KEYS rejects resolverMode, localeMode, qaMode with HTTP 400

trustedSources.mechanism: Internal test runner harness (Jest) explicitly invoking resolver with controlled options
Local environment variable GLCC_ENABLE_LOCAL_QA_MODE === 'true' or trusted dev caller
Trusted deployment environment variable GLCC_PREVIEW_QA_ENABLED === 'true' or internal Preview test harness

previewQaPolicy.nonUniversal: Ordinary Preview deployments without this flag run in standard PRODUCTION resolver mode. Preview users do not automatically receive QA mode permissions.

precedenceOrder.description: Signed guest preference cookie (rentipid_pref) or lightweight mirror (rentipid_locale)

productionEligibility.failClosedBehavior: Falls through to next precedence tier or platform default

controlledQaPolicy.justification: Allows fil-PH to be exercised in automated tests and local verification without exposing it as Production-selectable

rentipid_pref.security: HMAC-SHA256 signature verified in constant-time; rejects userId, role, chargeCurrency, permissions, resolverMode, localeMode, qaMode

rentipid_locale.role: Lightweight SSR and edge performance mirror
rentipid_locale.authority: Subordinate to rentipid_pref; validated against BCP-47 syntax, registry presence, and active resolver mode

hydrationParity.mechanism: TranslationProvider initializes directly from server-resolved initialLocale prop; zero effect-driven state flashing
